title: Police in Gujarat, India, to question Google after uncovering 500K+ Gmail IDs and passwords used to send hoax bomb threats to government offices since 2022 (Munsif Vengattil/Reuters)
summary: Munsif Vengattil / Reuters: Police in Gujarat, India, to question Google after uncovering 500K+ Gmail IDs and passwords used to send hoax bomb threats to government offices since 2022 — Indian police will question Google over a lack of safeguards after smashing a criminal network that set up and managed …
